primary_meaning: Sacred rest and cessation from labor, commemorating God's rest after creation and signifying the believer's spiritual rest and salvation-rest fulfilled in Christ

alternatives.meaning: Perpetual sign of the Mosaic covenant and mark of Israel's distinct identity/election
Type or shadow of the coming messianic/eschatological age and final eternal rest
Memorial of deliverance from Egyptian bondage and liberation
Ongoing literal seventh-day observance still binding as moral law (Sabbatarian reading)
Transferred or fulfilled in the Lord's Day (Sunday) as Christian celebration of resurrection

notes: Christian interpretation overwhelmingly centers on the rest motif (creational, soteriological, and eschatological), with broad agreement that the Sabbath functions typologically toward Christ even while debates persist over continuing literal observance versus fulfillment/transfer. The core symbolic association with rest is stable across traditions.
